** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Force Google account selection so "Đổi tài khoản" can switch accounts.** The denied screen and the role-error screen offer "Đổi tài khoản", which calls `signOut`. `_auth.signOut` signs out of Firebase only. It does not sign out of the Google session in the browser. `GoogleAuthProvider()` has no `prompt` parameter. Google can therefore reuse the single active Google account without showing the account chooser. When that happens, the denied account signs in again and the user returns to the denied screen with no way to choose another account in the app. Set `prompt: select_account` on the provider.
🐛 Proposed fix

```diff --- "a/web/lib/admin/admin_auth.dart" +++ "b/web/lib/admin/admin_auth.dart" @@ -65,7 +65,11 @@ final FirebaseFirestore _firestore; final AdminRoleCache _roleCache = AdminRoleCache(); late final AdminAuthMutations _mutations = AdminAuthMutations( - login: () => _auth.signInWithPopup(GoogleAuthProvider()).then((_) {}), + login: () => _auth + .signInWithPopup( + GoogleAuthProvider()..setCustomParameters({'prompt': 'select_account'}), + ) + .then((_) {}), logout: _auth.signOut, ); ```
Committable suggestion

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion login: () => _auth .signInWithPopup( GoogleAuthProvider()..setCustomParameters({'prompt': 'select_account'}), ) .then((_) {}), ```
